reasoning: A premium crypto trading dashboard needs information clarity, high visibility for kinetic triggers (price changes), and a pro-grade technical feel to replace generic purple gradients. An obsidian background with stark, vibrant accents ensures data hierarchy.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for large containers, p-4 for dense widgets
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, and dense content. Right-align numeric columns in tables.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Sharp edges, rounded-none or max rounded-sm (4px).

components.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS. Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse layout style. Dashboard panels use flat solid backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border), NO shadows by default.
components.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border (#262626) if content cuts off, or Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60) with 1px delicate inner stroke if content scrolls under.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary CTA in Volt Blue (#007AFF) or White. High contrast on hover.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border. Focus ring 2px Volt Blue (ring-[#007AFF]).
components.charts: Use Recharts. Minimalist grids, neon strokes for lines (Volt Blue, Acid Green), zero fill or extremely subtle gradient fills. Tooltips must be high-contrast with #050505 backgrounds.

motion.hover_states: Slight brightness increase, borders turn lighter grey or brand color.

icons.library: lucide-react (dense dashboards) combined with standard SVG crypto icons.

user_avatar.description: User avatar for the profile menu / portfolio section

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind classes for the main grid structures. Avoid overusing standard Shadcn Card component wrapping; go flat, rectangular, and cardless with sharp edges.
Implement the Global Market Stats Bar as a dense, horizontal overline section at the very top, using the monospaced font.
For tables, implement strict alignment (right for numbers, left for text) and use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values, prices, and tickers.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states with explicit text colors (e.g., hover:text-white) and hover:bg-[#111111].
Do NOT use generic purple gradients. Stick strictly to the stark Obsidian black base with bright Acid Green (#00FFAA) / Signal Red (#FF3B30) for market movements.

For the Market Heatmap (treemap), use varying opacities/shades of the positive (#00FFAA) and negative (#FF3B30) colors depending on performance percentage. Text inside must maintain APCA high contrast (use black text on the brightest green, white text on the deep red).
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="currency-toggle"', 'data-testid="buy-button"').
For Historical charts in the modal, use Recharts with a stark minimalist aesthetic, no grid lines or very faint #1A1A1A grid lines.
Install the required font families: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts or standard imports.
